raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fixes #43706 without breaking legacy single-key deployments.

When only `--api-key` is set (no `--admin-api-key`), `AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL` management endpoints still accept the ordinary key — intentional compat from #15908. Operators often miss that this makes every client credential a management credential.

This PR keeps that auth behavior, and:
1. Logs a startup **WARNING** when `api_key` is set and `admin_api_key` is unset, naming representative endpoints (`/update_weights_from_disk`, `/load_lora_adapter`, `/start_profile`) and recommending `--admin-api-key`.
2. Documents the single-key exposure in `--api-key` / `--admin-api-key` help text and server-args docs.

No change to `decide_request_auth` fallback when only `api_key` is configured.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3 test/registered/unit/utils/test_auth.py -v` (30 passed)
- [x] `python3 test/registered/unit/utils/test_http_server_auth.py -v` (6 passed)
- [x] `python3 test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args_docs_coverage.py -v` (4 passed)

Compare: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/compare/main...bantianyue:sglang:cursor/single-key-admin-warning-12e9?expand=1

 from __future__ import annotations
 
+import logging
 import secrets
 from dataclasses import dataclass
 from enum import Enum
 from typing import Any, Optional
 
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Representative ADMIN_OPTIONAL management routes. The ordinary key reaches
+# every endpoint tagged with that level; these are the ones operators most
+# often do not realize share the same credential as inference.
+ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLE_PATHS = (
+    "/update_weights_from_disk",
+    "/load_lora_adapter",
+    "/start_profile",
+)
+
+
+def _english_list(items: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
+    if len(items) <= 1:
+        return "".join(items)
+    if len(items) == 2:
+        return f"{items[0]} and {items[1]}"
+    return ", ".join(items[:-1]) + f", and {items[-1]}"
+
+
+_ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLES = _english_list(ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLE_PATHS)
+
+API_KEY_HELP = (
+    "Set API key of the server. It is also used in the OpenAI API compatible server. "
+    "When --admin-api-key is unset, this ordinary key also authorizes ADMIN_OPTIONAL "
+    f"management endpoints (for example {_ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLES}). "
+    "Set --admin-api-key to separate ordinary and management credentials."
+)
+ADMIN_API_KEY_HELP = (
+    "Set admin API key for sensitive management endpoints (for example "
+    f"{_english_list(ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLE_PATHS + ('/hicache/storage-backend/clear',))}). "
+    "When set, those endpoints require this key and do not accept --api-key. "
+    "If only --api-key is set, that ordinary key also authorizes ADMIN_OPTIONAL "
+    "management endpoints; configure --admin-api-key to separate ordinary and "
+    "management credentials."
+)
+
+_SINGLE_KEY_ADMIN_OPTIONAL_WARNING = (
+    "Only --api-key is set and --admin-api-key is unset. The ordinary API key "
+    "also authorizes ADMIN_OPTIONAL management endpoints such as "
+    f"{_ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLES}. Configure --admin-api-key to separate "
+    "ordinary and management credentials."
+)
+
 
 @dataclass(frozen=True)
 class AuthDecision:
@@ -127,7 +172,9 @@ def _check_bearer_token(
 
     # Optional-auth endpoints:

-    # - only api_key: require api_key

+    #   Startup logs a warning via warn_single_key_admin_optional; do not
+    #   reject the ordinary key here. A rejection needs a deprecation cycle.
     # - only admin_api_key: require admin_api_key
     # - both: require admin_api_key (api_key is NOT accepted)
     if auth_level == AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL:
@@ -151,6 +198,29 @@ def _check_bearer_token(
     return AuthDecision(allowed=True)
 
 
+def single_key_authorizes_admin_optional(
+    api_key: Optional[str], admin_api_key: Optional[str]
+) -> bool:
+    """True when the ordinary key is also the ADMIN_OPTIONAL credential.
+
+    Truthiness matches ``decide_request_auth``: an empty string counts as unset.
+    """
+    return bool(api_key) and not admin_api_key
+
+
+def warn_single_key_admin_optional(
+    api_key: Optional[str], admin_api_key: Optional[str]
+) -> None:
+    """Warn at startup when a single ordinary key is a management credential.
+
+    Does not change authorization. ``decide_request_auth`` still accepts
+    ``api_key`` for ``ADMIN_OPTIONAL`` when ``admin_api_key`` is unset.
+    """
+    if not single_key_authorizes_admin_optional(api_key, admin_api_key):
+        return
+    logger.warning(_SINGLE_KEY_ADMIN_OPTIONAL_WARNING)
+

@@ -314,6 +337,103 @@ def test_bearer_case_insensitive(self):
         )
         self.assertTrue(decision.allowed)
 
+    def test_admin_optional_legacy_single_key_compat(self):
+        """Ordinary keys still authorize ADMIN_OPTIONAL management routes.
+
+        The single-key fallback is the #15908 compatibility path. Issue #43706
+        warns about it; flipping this branch would reject existing deployments
+        that call management endpoints with only --api-key.
+        """
+        path = "/update_weights_from_disk"
+        cases = (
+            ("no_credential", None, "user-secret", None, False),
+            ("ordinary_api_key", "Bearer user-secret", "user-secret", None, True),
+            ("wrong_ordinary_key", "Bearer wrong", "user-secret", None, False),
+            (
+                "both_keys_ordinary_rejected",
+                "Bearer user-secret",
+                "user-secret",
+                "admin-secret",
+                False,
+            ),
+            (
+                "both_keys_admin_accepted",
+                "Bearer admin-secret",
+                "user-secret",
+                "admin-secret",
+                True,
+            ),
+            ("neither_key_open", None, None, None, True),
+            ("empty_strings_count_as_unset", None, "", "", True),
+        )
+        for name, header, api_key, admin_api_key, allowed in cases:
+            with self.subTest(name=name):
+                decision = decide_request_auth(
+                    method="POST",
+                    path=path,
+                    authorization_header=header,
+                    api_key=api_key,
+                    admin_api_key=admin_api_key,
+                    auth_level=AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL,
+                )
+                self.assertIs(decision.allowed, allowed)
+
+
+class TestSingleKeyAdminOptionalWarning(CustomTestCase):
+    """Startup warning for the legacy single-key management credential."""
+
+    def test_warns_only_for_the_single_key_shape(self):
+        shapes = (
+            ("ordinary_only", "user-secret", None, True),
+            ("both_keys", "user-secret", "admin-secret", False),
+            ("neither_key", None, None, False),
+            ("admin_only", None, "admin-secret", False),
+            ("empty_ordinary_key", "", None, False),
+            ("empty_admin_key_counts_as_unset", "user-secret", "", True),
+        )
+        for name, api_key, admin_api_key, expect_warning in shapes:
+            with self.subTest(name=name):
+                self.assertIs(
+                    single_key_authorizes_admin_optional(api_key, admin_api_key),
+                    expect_warning,
+                )
+                if expect_warning:
+                    with self.assertLogs(
+                        "sglang.srt.utils.auth", level="WARNING"
+                    ) as logs:
+                        warn_single_key_admin_optional(api_key, admin_api_key)
+                    text = "\n".join(logs.output)
+                    self.assertEqual(len(logs.records), 1)
+                    self.assertEqual(logs.records[0].levelname, "WARNING")
+                    for path in _ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLES:
+                        self.assertIn(path, text)
+                    self.assertIn("--admin-api-key", text)
+                    self.assertNotIn(str(api_key), text)
+                else:
+                    with self.assertNoLogs("sglang.srt.utils.auth", level="WARNING"):
+                        warn_single_key_admin_optional(api_key, admin_api_key)
+
+    def test_help_and_docs_name_the_exposure(self):
+        """Operators can see the single-key exposure without reading the issue."""
+        for help_text in (API_KEY_HELP, ADMIN_API_KEY_HELP):
+            for path in _ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLES:
+                self.assertIn(path, help_text)
+            self.assertIn("--admin-api-key", help_text)
+        self.assertIn("do not accept --api-key", ADMIN_API_KEY_HELP)
+
+        serving_source = _SERVING_FIELDS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        self.assertIn("API_KEY_HELP", serving_source)
+        self.assertIn("ADMIN_API_KEY_HELP", serving_source)
+
+        http_server = _HTTP_SERVER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        self.assertIn("warn_single_key_admin_optional(", http_server)
+
+        doc = _SERVER_ARGS_DOC.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        for path in _ADMIN_OPTIONAL_EXAMPLES:
+            self.assertGreaterEqual(doc.count(path), 2)
+        self.assertIn("ordinary API key also authorizes", doc)
+        self.assertIn("ordinary key also authorizes", doc)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
